subject: Trying to open a new webpage by clicking the actionButton in Shiny

messages.author: 3fdc02da1ddc82a5
messages.subject: Trying to open a new webpage by clicking the actionButton in Shiny
parts:
Hello,

Is there anyone who happen to know how to open a new webpage by triggering the action button when executing the Shiny App in server? 

Since I have several Shiny Apps, ideally, I'd like to build a welcome page with several button, which could redir the users to those Apps.

Thank you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Trying to open a new webpage by clicking the actionButton in Shiny
parts:
You don't need to use actionButton, just make an HTML <a> tag right in your ui.R:

tags$a(class="btn btn-default", href="{url}", "{description}")

I wasn't sure from your question whether you wanted it in a new window, if so then also include target="_blank" as an argument.

messages.subject: Re: Trying to open a new webpage by clicking the actionButton in Shiny
parts:
Thank you, Joe. That's very helpful. 

Finally, I made my code like:

shinyUI(
           HTML('<a href = ........><button style = "height:70px;width:100px"></button></a>)).

It's a nice discuss place. I alway get great insights from your guys help. 

Thanks again!
